Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

107	### 4.2 qkv 打包：一次握手搬三份张量
108	
109	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
110	
111	注意力需要 q、k、v 三份张量走同一趟交换。最直接的写法是对三者各调一次集合通信；本示例（以及 migration.md 推荐的形态）把三份沿最后一维拼成一个 `3 * head_dim` 的最后轴，**一次调用搬完**。示例 docstring 的收尾段专门强调这一点（[examples/dit_attention.py:15-16](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L15-L16)）：one handshake instead of three, for the same bytes。迁移表里对应的一行也是同一个意思：DeepSpeed 的三次 `_SeqAllToAll.apply`（q、k、v 各一次）在这里变成 `3 * head_dim` 最后轴上的一次调用（[docs/migration.md:52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L52)）。
112	
113	为什么「字节不变却更快」？因为成本分两类：
114	
115	- **按字节计费的带宽项**：传输 \(b \cdot s_{\text{local}} \cdot n_{\text{global}} \cdot 3d \cdot \text{elem}\) 字节——拼与不拼总量相同（ws=8 默认配置下是 \(1 \times 512 \times 32 \times 384 \times 2 = 12{,}582{,}912\) 字节 ≈ 12.6 MB）。
116	- **按次数计费的延迟项**：每次调用两道握手屏障 + 一次 copy_out，与消息大小基本无关。
117	
118	打包省的是第二类。粗略模型：
119	
120	\[
121	T_{\text{调用}} \approx 2\,T_{\text{屏障}} + T_{\text{传输}}(\text{字节}) + T_{\text{copy\_out}}
122	\]
123	
124	输入侧打包 1 次调用付 \(2\) 道屏障，拆开 3 次付 \(6\) 道；输出侧两种写法都只有一份注意力输出，都是 1 次调用。整层合计：**2 次调用 / 4 道屏障 vs 4 次调用 / 8 道屏障**，字节完全一样。综合实践（第 5 节）会实测这个差。
125	
126	正确性依赖一个关键事实：**`all_to_all_4d` 只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不混合最后一维**。因此「先交换后按最后一维 chunk」与「先按最后一维拆开再各自交换」取出的是同一组值——最后一维的任何切分都与交换可交换。这保证了 chunk 出的 q/k/v 与三次独立交换的结果逐位相同。
127	
128	折叠的位置也讲究。把 \((b, s, 3, n, d)\)（yunchang 的 5D 形态）免费 reshape 成 \((b, s, 3n, d)\) 看起来同样「打包了三份」，但 migration.md 明确标记它是陷阱：偶均分会沿合并后的 \(3n\) 轴切出**连续块**，每个 rank 收到的是「q 的某几个头 + k 的某几个头 + v 的某几个头」的混合物，而不是「同一批头的完整 q/k/v」（[docs/migration.md:143-145](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L143-L145)）。折叠进**最后一维**则不动 \((s, n)\) 两轴，rank 收到的仍是完整的头分片。示例因此让投影层直接以 \(3 \cdot n \cdot d\) 的输出顺序「上游就地发射」这个布局（[docs/migration.md:138](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L138)）。
129	
130	对齐也顺手核对：u2-l2 的规则是 \(d \times \text{elem\_size}\) 须为 16 的倍数；这里参与交换的最后一维 \(d = 3 \times 128 = 384\)，bf16 下 \(384 \times 2 = 768\)，\(768 \bmod 16 = 0\)，合法。
131	
132	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
133	
134	```text
135	Linear 输出 (b, s_local, n_global·3·head_dim)          ← 权重层面已经按 [头][3·head_dim] 排好
136	  └─ view → (b, s_local, n_global, 3·head_dim)          ← 纯 reshape，零拷贝
137	  └─ all_to_all_4d(mode=0)                              ← 一次握手搬三份
138	  └─ chunk(3, dim=-1) → q/k/v                           ← 交换缓冲上的跨步视图，零拷贝
139	```
140

142

147	#### 4.2.4 代码实践：验证「最后一维切分与交换可交换」
148	
149	这个实践**不需要 GPU、不需要本库**，纯 torch 在 CPU 上就能完成，同时复用你在 u1-l2 实践里写过的 mode 0 模拟。
150	
151	1. **实践目标**：证明「先交换后 chunk」与「先拆开后交换」取出同一组值——这正是三次独立调用能替换打包调用的正确性依据。
152	2. **操作步骤**（示例代码）：
153	
154	   ```python
155	   # 示例代码：纯 CPU 验证最后一维切分与 mode 0 交换可交换
156	   import torch
157	
158	   def mode0_shards(x, ws):
159	       """返回每个 rank 的 mode 0 输出：全序列 × 该 rank 的头分片。"""
160	       b, s, n, d = x.shape
161	       s_l, n_l = s // ws, n // ws
162	       outs = []
163	       for r in range(ws):
164	           seq_shards = [
165	               x[:, rr * s_l:(rr + 1) * s_l, r * n_l:(r + 1) * n_l, :]
166	               for rr in range(ws)
167	           ]                                   # 源 rank rr 的序列分片 × rank r 的头分片
168	           outs.append(torch.cat(seq_shards, dim=1))
169	       return outs
170	
171	   ws, b, s, n, hd = 4, 1, 32, 8, 16
172	   x = torch.randn(b, s, n, 3 * hd)            # 打包形态：最后一维 3·hd
173	
174	   a = mode0_shards(x, ws)                     # 路径 A：先交换
175	   a_q = [t.chunk(3, dim=-1)[0] for t in a]    #        后按最后一维取 q
176	
177	   q, k, v = x.view(b, s, n, 3, hd).unbind(dim=3)
178	   b_q = mode0_shards(q.contiguous(), ws)      # 路径 B：先拆出 q，再交换
179	
180	   assert all(torch.equal(p, c) for p, c in zip(a_q, b_q))
181	   print("chunk 与交换可交换：成立")
182	   ```
183	
184	3. **需要观察的现象**：断言通过；两条路径对每个 rank 的 q 逐位相等。
185	4. **预期结果**：必然通过——交换是纯置换，且只作用于 s、n 两轴。这个「参照重放」的验证思路与 `test/test_plan.py` 用主机端参照核对 plan 的做法同源（u3-l3 会精读）。

189	1. **问**：若 `head_dim=100`、dtype 为 bf16，打包后的调用合法吗？不打包呢？

196	### 4.3 参照对照：输出与梯度双校验
197	
198	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
199	
200	「交换是字节级置换」在单元测试里可以位精确，但一个真实的注意力块仍可能把张量接错轴——比如 mode 0 之后没 chunk 对位置、或转置转错轴，数据照样被搬运、测试照样「通过」。所以示例的校验不测集合通信本身，而是**测整个模块的行为**，并且测两样东西：前向输出和**输入梯度**。对照物是一个无序列并行的参照——同一个模块实例、同一份权重，一个 rank 上拿全序列算一遍（[examples/dit_attention.py:66-74](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L66-L74) 的 `reference` 函数，与 `forward` 唯一的区别就是没有两次 all_to_all）。docstring 把这层用意说得很直白（[examples/dit_attention.py:10-13](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L10-L13)）。
201	
202	双校验的三个方法学要点：
203	
204	1. **同一份数据**：全局输入在各 rank 上用同一份随机数构造再切片，参照算的就是「并行路径实际消费的那份数据」（[examples/dit_attention.py:88-94](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L88-L94)）。
205	2. **同一份权重**：各 rank 同种子初始化保证权重跨 rank 一致（[L82](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L82)）；参照直接复用 `block` 实例，且比较发生在任何 `opt.step()` 之前，权重逐位相同。
206	3. **allclose 而非 equal**：两条路径喂给 SDPA 的批布局不同（参照一次算 \(n_{\text{global}}\) 个头，并行路径每 rank 算 \(n_{\text{local}}\) 个头），且并行路径的 q/k/v 是交换缓冲的跨步视图、参照的是密集张量，浮点归约顺序不同必有微小差异。代码注释原话："attention is not a permutation, and the two paths reduce in different orders"（[examples/dit_attention.py:99-101](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L99-L101)）。
207	
208	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
209	
210	`main()` 中校验段落的顺序（顺序本身有讲究）：
211	
212	1. 并行路径前向 + 反向：`y_local = block(x_local)`、`y_local.sum().backward()`（[L96-L97](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L96-L97)），得到分片输出与 `x_local.grad`。
213	2. `dist.all_gather` 收集全部分片输出与全部分片梯度（[L102-L105](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L102-L105)）——用的是普通 `torch.distributed` 集合通信，校验基础设施不必也是被测物。
214	3. 参照路径前向 + 反向：`reference(block, x_global)`、`.sum().backward()`（[L107-L108](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L107-L108)），得到 `y_ref` 与 `x_global.grad`。
215	4. rank 0 上沿序列轴 `cat` 后做两个最大绝对误差：输出误差与梯度误差，先 `.float()` 再相减，阈值为 `tol = 5e-2`（[L110-L116](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L110-L116)）。

244	### 4.4 训练循环：五个优化器步
245	
246	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
247	
248	校验回答的是「一次前向 + 一次反向对不对」；训练循环回答的是另一个问题——**「能训练吗」**。一个集合通信可以在单测里位精确，却仍被接进错误的轴，导致梯度流断掉或炸掉，只有真实的优化器步能暴露这类问题。docstring 的最后一句话就是这个意思（[examples/dit_attention.py:12-13](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L12-L13)）。
249	
250	循环本身平平无奇：AdamW、固定随机目标、5 步 `mse_loss`。两个不平凡的点：
251	
252	- **梯度自动穿过两次集合通信**。`loss.backward()` 触发 mode 1 的 backward（= mode 0）和 mode 0 的 backward（= mode 1），两次反向交换由 C++ 算子的 autograd 公式自动完成——这正是 4.1 说「没有包装器」的另一面。数学细节（为什么 vjp 是逆排列、splits 为何不交换）留到 u6-l3。
253	- **loss 是 rank 本地的**。每个 rank 的 `mse_loss` 算的是自己序列分片对同一份随机目标的误差；各 rank 数字不同、也不应相同。这段循环证明「模块在训练」，不产生任何全局指标（[examples/dit_attention.py:126-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L126-L129) 的注释明说 ranks are not meant to agree）。
254	
255	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
256	
257	```text
258	构建 AdamW(block.parameters(), lr=1e-3) 与固定 target
259	循环 5 次:
260	    zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
261	    loss = mse_loss(block(x_local), target)   ← 两次正向交换
262	    loss.backward()                            ← 两次反向交换（另一个 mode）
263	    opt.step()
264	    rank 0 打印本 rank 分片的 loss
265	最后: block.group.destroy() → dist.destroy_process_group()   ← 顺序不可换
266	```
267	
268	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
269	
270	- 循环本体：[examples/dit_attention.py:118-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L118-L129)——`target = torch.randn_like(y_local)` 在循环**外**创建并固定，模块拟合的是这一个确定目标，loss 才应该单调下降。
271	- 收尾顺序：[examples/dit_attention.py:131-132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L131-L132)——`destroy()` 是集合操作（u2-l1：先同步 comm 流、再组内 barrier），必须先于 `dist.destroy_process_group()`，否则在 group 还活着时拆掉它脚下的进程组。
272	
273	#### 4.4.4 代码实践：确认梯度在流动
274	
275	1. **实践目标**：亲眼确认反向传播确实穿过了两次集合通信。
276	2. **操作步骤**：在你拷贝的 `my_dit.py` 里，把 `y_local.sum().backward()` 之后加两行（示例代码）：
277	
278	   ```python
279	   # 示例代码：检查输入梯度穿过了两次集合通信
280	   assert x_local.grad is not None, "梯度没有穿过 all_to_all"
281	   print(f"[r{rank}] |x_local.grad| = {x_local.grad.norm().item():.4f}")
282	   ```
283	
284	   运行 `torchrun --nproc_per_node=<N> my_dit.py`。
285	3. **需要观察的现象**：断言不触发；5 步 loss 大体下降（模块在拟合固定目标）；各 rank 的梯度范数不同。
286	4. **预期结果**：若把两次 `all_to_all_4d` 误接到错误的轴上，最典型的症状就是 `x_local.grad` 为 `None` 或全 0——这个断言是最便宜的烟雾测试。具体数值**待本地验证**。
287	
288	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
289	
290	1. **问**：`loss.backward()` 时两次 `all_to_all_4d` 各自的反向发生了什么？
291	   **答**：mode 0 的 backward 是 mode 1、mode 1 的 backward 是 mode 0，splits 原样传递不交换——由算子的 autograd 公式自动执行，示例里的两行注释（[L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L52)、[L61](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L61)）就是全部需要手写的文档（另见 [docs/migration.md:149-155](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L149-L155)；推导在 u6-l3）。
292	2. **问**：rank 0 打印的 loss 各 rank 相同吗？应该相同吗？
293	   **答**：不同、也不应相同。loss 是本 rank 序列分片对固定目标的 MSE，分片内容各 rank 不同；这段循环的目的是证明「能训练」，不是给出全局损失（[examples/dit_attention.py:126-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L126-L129)）。
294	3. **问**：把 `block.group.destroy()` 挪到 `dist.destroy_process_group()` 之后会怎样？
295	   **答**：`destroy()` 内部要做组内 barrier 并清理窗口与 comm 流，此时底层进程组已被拆掉，轻则报错重则挂起；u2-l1 讲过它是集合操作，顺序不可换（[examples/dit_attention.py:131-132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L131-L132)）。
296	
297	## 5. 综合实践
298	
299	把第 4 节的四条线串起来：**将示例的打包调用改成三次独立调用，先证等价、再量化代价、最后解释原因**。
300	
301	### 5.1 实践目标
302	
303	1. 验证：q/k/v 三次独立 `all_to_all_4d` 与一次打包调用，输出逐位（或 allclose 意义上）一致。
304	2. 量化：同样字节下，4 次调用对 2 次调用多付的时间，并用 `_timed` 的阶段分解指出时间去了哪。
305	3. 解释：写出「为什么字节相同但时间不同」的注释。
306	
307	### 5.2 操作步骤
308	
309	将下面的完整脚本（示例代码）保存为仓库根目录的 `dit_attention_3calls.py`（新文件，不改仓库源码），运行：
310	
311	```bash
312	torchrun --nproc_per_node=<N> dit_attention_3calls.py    # 计时请在 ws>=2 下进行
313	```
314	
315	```python
316	# 示例代码：三次独立调用 vs 一次打包调用
317	from __future__ import annotations
318	
319	import os
320	
321	import torch
322	import torch.distributed as dist
323	import torch.nn.functional as F
324	
325	from fast_ulysses import UlyssesGroup
326	
327	B, S_LOCAL, HEADS_PER_RANK, HEAD_DIM = 1, 512, 4, 128
328	
329	
330	class PackedAttention(torch.nn.Module):
331	    """与 examples/dit_attention.py 的 UlyssesAttention 相同：输入侧一次打包调用。"""
332	
333	    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
334	        super().__init__()
335	        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
336	        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
337	        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
338	
339	    def forward(self, x):
340	        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
341	        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3 * self.head_dim)
342	        qkv = self.group.all_to_all_4d(qkv, mode=0)                 # 握手 1/2（输入侧仅此一次）
343	        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
344	        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
345	            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
346	        ).transpose(1, 2)
347	        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 2/2
348	        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))
349	
350	
351	class ThreeCallAttention(torch.nn.Module):
352	    """q、k、v 各走一次 mode 0：同样字节，多两次握手。权重与 PackedAttention 共享。"""
353	
354	    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
355	        super().__init__()
356	        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
357	        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
358	        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
359	
360	    def forward(self, x):
361	        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
362	        # 同一个 Linear 的输出，只是把「打包」推迟：view 成 (…, n, 3, head_dim) 再 unbind，
363	        # 取到的三组值与原实现「先交换后 chunk(3, dim=-1)」完全相同——
364	        # 因为交换只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不混合最后一维（见 4.2.4 的纯 torch 验证）。
365	        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3, self.head_dim)
366	        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(dim=3)                  # 各 (b, s_local, n_global, head_dim)
367	        q = self.group.all_to_all_4d(q, mode=0)      # 握手 1/4
368	        k = self.group.all_to_all_4d(k, mode=0)      # 握手 2/4（同流串行，窗口复用是安全模式）
369	        v = self.group.all_to_all_4d(v, mode=0)      # 握手 3/4
370	        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
371	            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
372	        ).transpose(1, 2)                            # (b, s_global, n_local, head_dim)
373	        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 4/4（输出只有一份张量）
374	        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))
375	
376	
377	def bench(module, x, iters=20):
378	    for _ in range(5):          # 预热：触发新形状的集合性窗口分配与 SDPA 内核选择
379	        module(x)
380	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
381	    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(True), torch.cuda.Event(True)
382	    start.record()
383	    for _ in range(iters):
384	        module(x)
385	    end.record()
386	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
387	    return start.elapsed_time(end) / iters     # 毫秒
388	
389	
390	def main():
391	    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
392	    rank, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
393	    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank)))
394	    dev = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
395	    torch.manual_seed(0)
396	
397	    n_global = HEADS_PER_RANK * ws
398	    group = UlyssesGroup(require_nvlink=False)
399	    packed = PackedAttention(group, n_global, HEAD_DIM).to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
400	    three = ThreeCallAttention(group, n_global, HEAD_DIM).to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
401	    three.load_state_dict(packed.state_dict())   # 权重逐位相同：差异只能来自路径本身
402	
403	    s_global = S_LOCAL * ws
404	    x = torch.randn(B, s_global, n_global * HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
405	    x_local = x[:, rank * S_LOCAL:(rank + 1) * S_LOCAL]
406	
407	    # 1) 等价性：同样权重、同样字节，输出应一致
408	    with torch.no_grad():
409	        err = (packed(x_local).float() - three(x_local).float()).abs().max().item()
410	        t_packed, t_three = bench(packed, x_local), bench(three, x_local)
411	
412	        # 2) 阶段分解：_timed 把一次调用切成 barrier_in/transfer/barrier_out/copy_out
413	        big = torch.randn(B, S_LOCAL, n_global, 3 * HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
414	        small = torch.randn(B, S_LOCAL, n_global, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
415	        for t in (big, small):                   # 先预热：新形状首调会触发集合性窗口分配
416	            group.all_to_all_4d(t, mode=0)
417	        _, st_big = group._timed(big, mode=0)    # 打包形态 d=384 的一次调用
418	        _, st_small = group._timed(small, mode=0)  # 拆开形态 d=128 的一次调用
419	
420	    if rank == 0:
421	        print(f"ws={ws}  max |packed - three| = {err:.6f}")
422	        print(f"packed : {t_packed:.3f} ms/iter")
423	        print(f"three  : {t_three:.3f} ms/iter  ({t_three / t_packed:.2f}x)")
424	        print(f"packed d=384 stages (ms): { {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in st_big.items()} }")
425	        print(f"single d=128 stages (ms): { {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in st_small.items()} }")
426	
427	    # 为什么字节相同、时间不同：
428	    # 输入侧要搬运的总字节都是 b*s_local*n_global*3*head_dim*elem_size，但每次
429	    # all_to_all_4d 都要付两道与消息大小基本无关的标志位屏障（barrier_in/barrier_out）
430	    # 和一次 copy_out——这些是按「次数」计费的延迟项；传输本身才是按字节计费的带宽项。
431	    # 打包把输入侧 3 次调用（6 道屏障、3 次 copy_out）合并为 1 次（2 道屏障、1 次
432	    # copy_out），省下的是 4 道屏障加 2 次 copy_out 的固定延迟，带宽项一分未变。
433	    # 注意：ws=1 时屏障被整体跳过（u1-l3），这项差异归零——计时请在 ws>=2 下做。
434	    group.destroy()
435	    dist.destroy_process_group()
436	
437	
438	if __name__ == "__main__":
439	    main()
440	```
441	
442	### 5.3 需要观察的现象
443	
444	- 等价性一行：`max |packed - three|` 应为 0 或极小（两条路径喂给 SDPA 的 q/k/v 一个是交换缓冲的跨步视图、一个是密集张量，SDPA 可能选不同内核，故用与示例一致的宽容差判断；建议同时打印 `torch.equal(...)` 看是否碰巧逐位相等）。
445	- 计时两行：`three` 的每次迭代应慢于 `packed`，比值大于 1。
446	- 阶段分解两行：`d=384` 与 `d=128` 两次调用的 `transfer` 大致与字节成比例（约为 3 倍关系），而 `barrier_in`/`barrier_out` 两次都接近同一个「与大小无关」的小常数——这就是延迟项与带宽项的分界。`_timed` 的阶段名与定义见 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:251-265](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L251-L265)（阶段数值为毫秒，与 [benchmark/bench_a2a.py:198](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/benchmark/bench_a2a.py#L198) 的用法同口径；注意 docstring 标明它仅供基准、读事件会同步）。
447	
448	### 5.4 预期结果
449	
450	- 输出等价成立（4.2.4 已从「交换不碰最后一维」给出结构性论证）。
451	- 慢的幅度由 4 道额外屏障 + 2 次额外 copy_out 的固定延迟决定；消息越小（本例仅约 12.6 MB），延迟项占比越大，比值越难看。具体数字**待本地验证**——请在 ws≥2、空闲的 GPU 上运行并记录。
452	- 若把 `--nproc_per_node=1` 跑一遍：等价性仍成立，但两个版本耗时几乎相同——因为 ws=1 时屏障被整体跳过，延迟项消失。这个「负对照」本身就是对「时间差来自握手」的交叉验证。
453	
454	## 6. 本讲小结
455	
456	- `examples/dit_attention.py` 是本库推荐形态的完整样例：fast-ulysses 只交付集合通信，注意力内核与两次调用的编排归调用方；模块因此是普通 `nn.Module`，没有 `autograd.Function` 包装。
457	- qkv 沿最后一维打包成 \(3 \cdot \text{head\_dim}\)：字节不变、输入侧握手由 3 次并为 1 次；正确性依赖「交换只重排 s/n 轴、从不混合最后一维」，故与最后一维的任何切分可交换；折叠进 n 轴的 5D 变体则是混头的陷阱。
458	- 校验方法学：与同权重、同数据的单卡参照比较输出**和**输入梯度；`allclose` 而非 `equal`（差异来自 SDPA 的归约顺序，不是交换本身）；先 `.float()` 再求差，容差 `5e-2` 对应 bf16 穿过注意力加两次投影的量纲。
459	- 五个优化器步证明的是「能训练」而非「一次正确」；梯度自动穿过两次交换（backward = 另一个 mode），loss 是 rank 本地量。
460	- 成本模型：\(T_{\text{调用}} \approx 2T_{\text{屏障}} + T_{\text{传输}}(\text{字节}) + T_{\text{copy\_out}}\)——打包优化的是按次数计费的延迟项，不是带宽项。
461	
462	## 7. 下一步学习建议
463	
464	下一讲进入 u3 单元：**u3-l1（A2ADims / CopyOp / A2APlan：寻址的纯主机表达）**。本讲你一直把 `all_to_all_4d` 当黑盒用；u3 将打开 [src/a2a_plan.cc](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L1-L1) 所在的纯主机层，看「序列⇄头重排」如何被编译成一组带源/目的步长的字节拷贝——其中 mode 0 的发射逻辑正是本讲那次打包调用的真身。
465	
466	顺路可读：
467	
468	- [docs/api.md](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/api.md#L1-L1) 的 Raises 全表——把本讲用到的契约再对一遍；
469	- u6-l3 将给出「backward 是另一个 mode」的完整推导，回答本讲 4.4 遗留的为什么；
470	- [benchmark/bench_a2a.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/benchmark/bench_a2a.py#L1-L1) 的 `stages` 模式（u9-l4 精读）——本讲综合实践里 `_timed` 的工业版用法。

# 实例精读：序列并行 DiT 注意力块

## 1. 本讲目标

前面几讲我们把 `all_to_all_4d` 的形状契约、错误检查与不均匀分片逐一拆开了。本讲换一个视角：**站在使用者一边**，逐段精读 [examples/dit_attention.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L1-L137) ——一个完整的、可训练的序列并行注意力块，看这些契约如何拼成一个真实模块。

读完本讲，你应该能：

1. 读懂 `UlyssesAttention` 的每一层职责：它是一个**普通的 `nn.Module`**，没有 `autograd.Function` 包装，两次 all-to-all 包夹一次 SDPA。
2. 解释 qkv 打包进最后一维（`3 * head_dim`）的动机与正确性：为什么是「一次握手搬三份张量」，以及为什么这种折叠是安全的、而另一种看似等价的折叠是陷阱。
3. 复现示例的双校验方法学：与「无序列并行的单卡参照」比较输出**和**输入梯度，理解为什么用 `allclose` 而不是 `equal`、容差为什么是 `5e-2`。
4. 说出五个优化器步想证明什么、不证明什么。
5. 完成综合实践：把一次打包调用拆成对 q、k、v 的三次独立调用，验证输出等价，并用 CUDA 事件或 `_timed` 量化「字节相同、握手次数不同」带来的时间差。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已读过 u1-l2（Ulysses 原理）、u2-l1（Group 构造）、u2-l2（形状契约）。三个本讲会用到的结论，先摆出来：

| 结论 | 出处 | 一句话回顾 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mode 0 把 \((b, s_{\text{local}}, n_{\text{global}}, d)\) 变成 \((b, s_{\text{global}}, n_{\text{local}}, d)\)，mode 1 是严格逆变换 | u1-l2 / u2-l2 | 两次交换都是纯字节搬运，往返位精确 |
| 一次同步调用的内部链路是 prepare → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out | u1-l4 | **每次调用付两道与消息大小无关的握手屏障** |
| dtype 白名单 + \(d \times \text{elem\_size}\) 必须是 16 的倍数 | u2-l2 | bf16 的 elem_size 是 2 字节 |

再补两个本讲特有的术语：

- **SDPA**（scaled dot-product attention）：`torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention`，计算 \(\text{softmax}(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k})V\)。关键性质是**按头独立**——每个头在自己的 \((s, d)\) 子空间里做注意力，头与头之间不交换数据。整块「三明治」结构之所以成立，靠的就是它（u1-l2 讲过）。
- **DiT**（Diffusion Transformer）：视频/图像扩散模型用的 Transformer 变体，长序列训练是其典型场景，也是本库的主要目标负载。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 模块结构：一个普通的 `nn.Module`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

DeepSpeed、sglang、yunchang 都交付一个**注意力模块**（`DistributedAttention` / `UlyssesAttention` / `LongContextAttention`），由它持有 q/k/v 交换、注意力调用和输出交换。fast-ulysses 只交付**集合通信本身**——你用两次调用加上自己的注意力内核替换掉那个模块。这是迁移文档开门见山强调的结构性差异：[docs/migration.md:6-10](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L6-L10)，而 `examples/dit_attention.py` 就是这种形态的完整样例（[docs/migration.md:157-163](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L157-L163)）。

这个模块最值得注意的「结构」是它**没有结构**：没有 `autograd.Function` 包装、没有手写 backward。因为 `all_to_all_4d` 在 C++ 里就是可微的，backward 是另一个 mode，包装器被「删除」而不是「翻译」过来（[docs/migration.md:149-155](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L149-L155)）。所以它长得和任何一个单卡注意力块一模一样——这正是示例 docstring 的第一条说明（[examples/dit_attention.py:5-8](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L5-L8)）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次前向的数据流（形状以默认配置 ws=8 为例，常量在 [examples/dit_attention.py:29](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L29)：`B=1, S_LOCAL=512, HEADS_PER_RANK=4, HEAD_DIM=128`，故 \(n_{\text{global}} = 4 \times 8 = 32\)，隐藏维 \(= 32 \times 128 = 4096\)）：

```text
x                    (1, 512, 4096) = (b, s_local, n_global·head_dim)   ← 调用方已有的序列分片
 ├─ Linear qkv + view → (1, 512, 32, 384)      打包：最后一维 = 3·head_dim
 ├─ all_to_all_4d(mode=0) → (1, 4096, 4, 384)  交换：序列分片 ⇄ 头分片
 ├─ chunk(3, dim=-1) → q/k/v 各 (1, 4096, 4, 128)
 ├─ SDPA（按头独立，全序列本地算）→ (1, 4096, 4, 128)
 ├─ all_to_all_4d(mode=1) → (1, 512, 32, 128)  换回：头分片 ⇄ 序列分片
 └─ Linear proj → (1, 512, 4096)               输出仍是「本 rank 的序列分片、全部头」
```

输入输出契约是对称的：进出都是调用方自己那段序列分片、全部的头，模块内部（两次集合通信之间）才看到全序列＋头分片——类 docstring 写明了这一点（[examples/dit_attention.py:33-37](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L33-L37)）。

1. **问**：为什么模块的输出是 `(b, s_local, n_global·head_dim)`，而不是含全序列的形状？
   **答**：mode 1 已经把头分片换回了序列分片；模块的输入输出契约是对称的——调用方自始至终只持有自己的序列分片和全部的头，整条序列只在两次集合通信**之间**存在（[examples/dit_attention.py:33-37](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L33-L37)）。
2. **问**：一个 DeepSpeed 用户要把 `DistributedAttention(local_attn, sp_group)` 迁移过来，模块层面要补什么、删什么？
   **答**：补——对 `local_attn`（自己的注意力内核）的显式调用和两次 `all_to_all_4d`；删——`_SeqAllToAll` 那个 `autograd.Function` 包装，`all_to_all_4d` 本身可微，包装器直接删除（[docs/migration.md:48-56](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L48-L56)）。
3. **问**：为什么 `UlyssesAttention` 在构造时保存 group，而不是每次 forward 新建一个？
   **答**：group 持有对称内存窗口、plan 缓存和 comm 流，构造又是集合操作；正确纪律是建一次、长期持有（[docs/migration.md:233-238](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L233-L238)）。

### 4.2 qkv 打包：一次握手搬三份张量

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

注意力需要 q、k、v 三份张量走同一趟交换。最直接的写法是对三者各调一次集合通信；本示例（以及 migration.md 推荐的形态）把三份沿最后一维拼成一个 `3 * head_dim` 的最后轴，**一次调用搬完**。示例 docstring 的收尾段专门强调这一点（[examples/dit_attention.py:15-16](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L15-L16)）：one handshake instead of three, for the same bytes。迁移表里对应的一行也是同一个意思：DeepSpeed 的三次 `_SeqAllToAll.apply`（q、k、v 各一次）在这里变成 `3 * head_dim` 最后轴上的一次调用（[docs/migration.md:52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L52)）。

为什么「字节不变却更快」？因为成本分两类：

- **按字节计费的带宽项**：传输 \(b \cdot s_{\text{local}} \cdot n_{\text{global}} \cdot 3d \cdot \text{elem}\) 字节——拼与不拼总量相同（ws=8 默认配置下是 \(1 \times 512 \times 32 \times 384 \times 2 = 12{,}582{,}912\) 字节 ≈ 12.6 MB）。
- **按次数计费的延迟项**：每次调用两道握手屏障 + 一次 copy_out，与消息大小基本无关。

打包省的是第二类。粗略模型：

\[
T_{\text{调用}} \approx 2\,T_{\text{屏障}} + T_{\text{传输}}(\text{字节}) + T_{\text{copy\_out}}
\]

输入侧打包 1 次调用付 \(2\) 道屏障，拆开 3 次付 \(6\) 道；输出侧两种写法都只有一份注意力输出，都是 1 次调用。整层合计：**2 次调用 / 4 道屏障 vs 4 次调用 / 8 道屏障**，字节完全一样。综合实践（第 5 节）会实测这个差。

正确性依赖一个关键事实：**`all_to_all_4d` 只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不混合最后一维**。因此「先交换后按最后一维 chunk」与「先按最后一维拆开再各自交换」取出的是同一组值——最后一维的任何切分都与交换可交换。这保证了 chunk 出的 q/k/v 与三次独立交换的结果逐位相同。

折叠的位置也讲究。把 \((b, s, 3, n, d)\)（yunchang 的 5D 形态）免费 reshape 成 \((b, s, 3n, d)\) 看起来同样「打包了三份」，但 migration.md 明确标记它是陷阱：偶均分会沿合并后的 \(3n\) 轴切出**连续块**，每个 rank 收到的是「q 的某几个头 + k 的某几个头 + v 的某几个头」的混合物，而不是「同一批头的完整 q/k/v」（[docs/migration.md:143-145](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L143-L145)）。折叠进**最后一维**则不动 \((s, n)\) 两轴，rank 收到的仍是完整的头分片。示例因此让投影层直接以 \(3 \cdot n \cdot d\) 的输出顺序「上游就地发射」这个布局（[docs/migration.md:138](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L138)）。

对齐也顺手核对：u2-l2 的规则是 \(d \times \text{elem\_size}\) 须为 16 的倍数；这里参与交换的最后一维 \(d = 3 \times 128 = 384\)，bf16 下 \(384 \times 2 = 768\)，\(768 \bmod 16 = 0\)，合法。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
Linear 输出 (b, s_local, n_global·3·head_dim)          ← 权重层面已经按 [头][3·head_dim] 排好
  └─ view → (b, s_local, n_global, 3·head_dim)          ← 纯 reshape，零拷贝
  └─ all_to_all_4d(mode=0)                              ← 一次握手搬三份
  └─ chunk(3, dim=-1) → q/k/v                           ← 交换缓冲上的跨步视图，零拷贝
```

#### 4.2.4 代码实践：验证「最后一维切分与交换可交换」

这个实践**不需要 GPU、不需要本库**，纯 torch 在 CPU 上就能完成，同时复用你在 u1-l2 实践里写过的 mode 0 模拟。

1. **实践目标**：证明「先交换后 chunk」与「先拆开后交换」取出同一组值——这正是三次独立调用能替换打包调用的正确性依据。
2. **操作步骤**（示例代码）：

   ```python
   # 示例代码：纯 CPU 验证最后一维切分与 mode 0 交换可交换
   import torch

   def mode0_shards(x, ws):
       """返回每个 rank 的 mode 0 输出：全序列 × 该 rank 的头分片。"""
       b, s, n, d = x.shape
       s_l, n_l = s // ws, n // ws
       outs = []
       for r in range(ws):
           seq_shards = [
               x[:, rr * s_l:(rr + 1) * s_l, r * n_l:(r + 1) * n_l, :]
               for rr in range(ws)
           ]                                   # 源 rank rr 的序列分片 × rank r 的头分片
           outs.append(torch.cat(seq_shards, dim=1))
       return outs

   ws, b, s, n, hd = 4, 1, 32, 8, 16
   x = torch.randn(b, s, n, 3 * hd)            # 打包形态：最后一维 3·hd

   a = mode0_shards(x, ws)                     # 路径 A：先交换
   a_q = [t.chunk(3, dim=-1)[0] for t in a]    #        后按最后一维取 q

   q, k, v = x.view(b, s, n, 3, hd).unbind(dim=3)
   b_q = mode0_shards(q.contiguous(), ws)      # 路径 B：先拆出 q，再交换

   assert all(torch.equal(p, c) for p, c in zip(a_q, b_q))
   print("chunk 与交换可交换：成立")
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：断言通过；两条路径对每个 rank 的 q 逐位相等。
4. **预期结果**：必然通过——交换是纯置换，且只作用于 s、n 两轴。这个「参照重放」的验证思路与 `test/test_plan.py` 用主机端参照核对 plan 的做法同源（u3-l3 会精读）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：若 `head_dim=100`、dtype 为 bf16，打包后的调用合法吗？不打包呢？
   **答**：都不合法。对齐约束作用于参与交换的最后一维：打包 \(3 \times 100 = 300\)，\(300 \times 2 = 600\)，\(600 \bmod 16 = 8 \ne 0\)；不打包 \(100 \times 2 = 200\)，\(200 \bmod 16 = 8 \ne 0\)。两者都会被 u2-l2 讲过的对齐检查以 `RuntimeError` 拒绝——打包与否不改变约束本身，只决定要检查几次。
2. **问**：`(b, s, 3, n, d) → (b, s, 3n, d)` 的免费 reshape 为什么是陷阱，而 `(…, 3·head_dim)` 为什么安全？
   **答**：前者把 3 折进了会被均分切开的 n 轴，每个 rank 收到的连续块里混着 q/k/v 各自的一部分头；后者只加宽不被切分的最后一维，rank 收到的仍是「同一批头 × 完整的 q/k/v 三段」（[docs/migration.md:143-145](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L143-L145)）。
3. **问**：ws=8 时，打包与不打包两种写法的整层调用次数、屏障次数各是多少？
   **答**：打包 = 输入侧 1 次 + 输出侧 1 次 = 2 次调用、4 道屏障；q/k/v 拆开 = 3 + 1 = 4 次调用、8 道屏障（每次调用 barrier_in + barrier_out 两道，见 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:264](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L264) 的阶段名）。与 ws 无关。

### 4.3 参照对照：输出与梯度双校验

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

「交换是字节级置换」在单元测试里可以位精确，但一个真实的注意力块仍可能把张量接错轴——比如 mode 0 之后没 chunk 对位置、或转置转错轴，数据照样被搬运、测试照样「通过」。所以示例的校验不测集合通信本身，而是**测整个模块的行为**，并且测两样东西：前向输出和**输入梯度**。对照物是一个无序列并行的参照——同一个模块实例、同一份权重，一个 rank 上拿全序列算一遍（[examples/dit_attention.py:66-74](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L66-L74) 的 `reference` 函数，与 `forward` 唯一的区别就是没有两次 all_to_all）。docstring 把这层用意说得很直白（[examples/dit_attention.py:10-13](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L10-L13)）。

双校验的三个方法学要点：

1. **同一份数据**：全局输入在各 rank 上用同一份随机数构造再切片，参照算的就是「并行路径实际消费的那份数据」（[examples/dit_attention.py:88-94](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L88-L94)）。
2. **同一份权重**：各 rank 同种子初始化保证权重跨 rank 一致（[L82](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L82)）；参照直接复用 `block` 实例，且比较发生在任何 `opt.step()` 之前，权重逐位相同。
3. **allclose 而非 equal**：两条路径喂给 SDPA 的批布局不同（参照一次算 \(n_{\text{global}}\) 个头，并行路径每 rank 算 \(n_{\text{local}}\) 个头），且并行路径的 q/k/v 是交换缓冲的跨步视图、参照的是密集张量，浮点归约顺序不同必有微小差异。代码注释原话："attention is not a permutation, and the two paths reduce in different orders"（[examples/dit_attention.py:99-101](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L99-L101)）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`main()` 中校验段落的顺序（顺序本身有讲究）：

1. 并行路径前向 + 反向：`y_local = block(x_local)`、`y_local.sum().backward()`（[L96-L97](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L96-L97)），得到分片输出与 `x_local.grad`。
2. `dist.all_gather` 收集全部分片输出与全部分片梯度（[L102-L105](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L102-L105)）——用的是普通 `torch.distributed` 集合通信，校验基础设施不必也是被测物。
3. 参照路径前向 + 反向：`reference(block, x_global)`、`.sum().backward()`（[L107-L108](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L107-L108)），得到 `y_ref` 与 `x_global.grad`。
4. rank 0 上沿序列轴 `cat` 后做两个最大绝对误差：输出误差与梯度误差，先 `.float()` 再相减，阈值为 `tol = 5e-2`（[L110-L116](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L110-L116)）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

- 参照函数：[examples/dit_attention.py:66-74](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L66-L74)——与 `forward` 逐行同构，只少两次 `all_to_all_4d`；`module.qkv`/`module.proj` 复用的是同一个模块的权重。
- 数据构造：[examples/dit_attention.py:88-94](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L88-L94)——`x_global` 先 `requires_grad_(True)`，再 `detach()` 切片后给 `x_local` 也加 `requires_grad_(True)`：两套叶子各自攒各自的梯度，互不干扰。
- 比较与容差：[examples/dit_attention.py:110-116](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L110-L116)——`.float()` 把 bf16 升到 float32 再求差；`tol = 5e-2` 旁的注释给出量纲依据："bfloat16 through attention plus two projections"（bf16 精度 + 注意力 + 两次投影的合理上限）。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践：ws=1 的退化运行

1. **实践目标**：在最小环境下跑通校验，并解释 ws=1 与 ws=8 两个误差数字的差别来自哪里。
2. **操作步骤**：单卡即可运行（nccl 后端仍需一块 GPU）：

   ```bash
   torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 examples/dit_attention.py
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：头部打印 `ws=1 s_global=512 n_global=4`；两行误差均应显示 `0.0000 OK`。
4. **预期结果**：ws=1 时两条路径执行的是**同一串算子、同一布局**（mode 0 在 ws=1 不改变形状，参照与并行路径的 chunk 都是同一缓冲上的同跨步视图），因此误差应精确为 0；ws≥2 时误差变为「非零但小于 5e-2」。两个数字对比正好把 4.3.1 的第 3 点（差异来自注意力归约顺序，而非交换本身）钉死。**待本地验证**。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：为什么相减前要把两边都 `.float()`？
   **答**：bf16 只有约 3 位十进制有效数字，在 bf16 里做减法本身就会把误差舍入掉；升到 float32 再取最大绝对误差，得到的才是有意义的误差度量（[examples/dit_attention.py:111-112](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L111-L112)）。
2. **问**：参照为什么复用 `block` 实例，而不是同种子再 new 一个？
   **答**：比较的前提是权重逐位相同。复用实例（且比较先于任何 `opt.step()`）把这一点变成结构性保证，而不是靠「种子相同」这个间接条件；种子相同在 L82 解决的是另一个问题——各 rank 之间权重一致。
3. **问**：把判据改成 `torch.equal` 会怎样？
   **答**：几乎必然失败。交换本身位精确，但两条路径的 SDPA 头数批布局不同、q/k/v 一个跨步一个密集，浮点归约顺序不同产生微小差异——这正是注释选 allclose 的原因（[examples/dit_attention.py:99-101](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L99-L101)）。

### 4.4 训练循环：五个优化器步

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

校验回答的是「一次前向 + 一次反向对不对」；训练循环回答的是另一个问题——**「能训练吗」**。一个集合通信可以在单测里位精确，却仍被接进错误的轴，导致梯度流断掉或炸掉，只有真实的优化器步能暴露这类问题。docstring 的最后一句话就是这个意思（[examples/dit_attention.py:12-13](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L12-L13)）。

循环本身平平无奇：AdamW、固定随机目标、5 步 `mse_loss`。两个不平凡的点：

- **梯度自动穿过两次集合通信**。`loss.backward()` 触发 mode 1 的 backward（= mode 0）和 mode 0 的 backward（= mode 1），两次反向交换由 C++ 算子的 autograd 公式自动完成——这正是 4.1 说「没有包装器」的另一面。数学细节（为什么 vjp 是逆排列、splits 为何不交换）留到 u6-l3。
- **loss 是 rank 本地的**。每个 rank 的 `mse_loss` 算的是自己序列分片对同一份随机目标的误差；各 rank 数字不同、也不应相同。这段循环证明「模块在训练」，不产生任何全局指标（[examples/dit_attention.py:126-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L126-L129) 的注释明说 ranks are not meant to agree）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
构建 AdamW(block.parameters(), lr=1e-3) 与固定 target
循环 5 次:
    zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    loss = mse_loss(block(x_local), target)   ← 两次正向交换
    loss.backward()                            ← 两次反向交换（另一个 mode）
    opt.step()
    rank 0 打印本 rank 分片的 loss
最后: block.group.destroy() → dist.destroy_process_group()   ← 顺序不可换
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

- 循环本体：[examples/dit_attention.py:118-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L118-L129)——`target = torch.randn_like(y_local)` 在循环**外**创建并固定，模块拟合的是这一个确定目标，loss 才应该单调下降。
- 收尾顺序：[examples/dit_attention.py:131-132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L131-L132)——`destroy()` 是集合操作（u2-l1：先同步 comm 流、再组内 barrier），必须先于 `dist.destroy_process_group()`，否则在 group 还活着时拆掉它脚下的进程组。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践：确认梯度在流动

1. **实践目标**：亲眼确认反向传播确实穿过了两次集合通信。
2. **操作步骤**：在你拷贝的 `my_dit.py` 里，把 `y_local.sum().backward()` 之后加两行（示例代码）：

   ```python

   assert x_local.grad is not None, "梯度没有穿过 all_to_all"
   print(f"[r{rank}] |x_local.grad| = {x_local.grad.norm().item():.4f}")
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：断言不触发；5 步 loss 大体下降（模块在拟合固定目标）；各 rank 的梯度范数不同。
4. **预期结果**：若把两次 `all_to_all_4d` 误接到错误的轴上，最典型的症状就是 `x_local.grad` 为 `None` 或全 0——这个断言是最便宜的烟雾测试。具体数值**待本地验证**。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：`loss.backward()` 时两次 `all_to_all_4d` 各自的反向发生了什么？
   **答**：mode 0 的 backward 是 mode 1、mode 1 的 backward 是 mode 0，splits 原样传递不交换——由算子的 autograd 公式自动执行，示例里的两行注释（[L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L52)、[L61](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L61)）就是全部需要手写的文档（另见 [docs/migration.md:149-155](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L149-L155)；推导在 u6-l3）。
2. **问**：rank 0 打印的 loss 各 rank 相同吗？应该相同吗？
   **答**：不同、也不应相同。loss 是本 rank 序列分片对固定目标的 MSE，分片内容各 rank 不同；这段循环的目的是证明「能训练」，不是给出全局损失（[examples/dit_attention.py:126-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L126-L129)）。
3. **问**：把 `block.group.destroy()` 挪到 `dist.destroy_process_group()` 之后会怎样？
   **答**：`destroy()` 内部要做组内 barrier 并清理窗口与 comm 流，此时底层进程组已被拆掉，轻则报错重则挂起；u2-l1 讲过它是集合操作，顺序不可换（[examples/dit_attention.py:131-132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L131-L132)）。

### 5.1 实践目标

### 5.2 操作步骤

将下面的完整脚本（示例代码）保存为仓库根目录的 `dit_attention_3calls.py`（新文件，不改仓库源码），运行：

```bash

```

```python
# 示例代码：三次独立调用 vs 一次打包调用
from __future__ import annotations

import os

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.nn.functional as F

from fast_ulysses import UlyssesGroup

B, S_LOCAL, HEADS_PER_RANK, HEAD_DIM = 1, 512, 4, 128


class PackedAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """与 examples/dit_attention.py 的 UlyssesAttention 相同：输入侧一次打包调用。"""

    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3 * self.head_dim)
        qkv = self.group.all_to_all_4d(qkv, mode=0)                 # 握手 1/2（输入侧仅此一次）
        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 2/2
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))


class ThreeCallAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """q、k、v 各走一次 mode 0：同样字节，多两次握手。权重与 PackedAttention 共享。"""

    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        # 同一个 Linear 的输出，只是把「打包」推迟：view 成 (…, n, 3, head_dim) 再 unbind，
        # 取到的三组值与原实现「先交换后 chunk(3, dim=-1)」完全相同——
        # 因为交换只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不混合最后一维（见 4.2.4 的纯 torch 验证）。
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3, self.head_dim)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(dim=3)                  # 各 (b, s_local, n_global, head_dim)
        q = self.group.all_to_all_4d(q, mode=0)      # 握手 1/4
        k = self.group.all_to_all_4d(k, mode=0)      # 握手 2/4（同流串行，窗口复用是安全模式）
        v = self.group.all_to_all_4d(v, mode=0)      # 握手 3/4
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)                            # (b, s_global, n_local, head_dim)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 4/4（输出只有一份张量）
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))


def bench(module, x, iters=20):
    for _ in range(5):          # 预热：触发新形状的集合性窗口分配与 SDPA 内核选择
        module(x)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(True), torch.cuda.Event(True)
    start.record()
    for _ in range(iters):
        module(x)
    end.record()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return start.elapsed_time(end) / iters     # 毫秒


def main():
    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
    rank, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank)))
    dev = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
    torch.manual_seed(0)

    n_global = HEADS_PER_RANK * ws
    group = UlyssesGroup(require_nvlink=False)
    packed = PackedAttention(group, n_global, HEAD_DIM).to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    three = ThreeCallAttention(group, n_global, HEAD_DIM).to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    three.load_state_dict(packed.state_dict())   # 权重逐位相同：差异只能来自路径本身

    s_global = S_LOCAL * ws
    x = torch.randn(B, s_global, n_global * HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
    x_local = x[:, rank * S_LOCAL:(rank + 1) * S_LOCAL]

    # 1) 等价性：同样权重、同样字节，输出应一致

        err = (packed(x_local).float() - three(x_local).float()).abs().max().item()
        t_packed, t_three = bench(packed, x_local), bench(three, x_local)

        # 2) 阶段分解：_timed 把一次调用切成 barrier_in/transfer/barrier_out/copy_out

        small = torch.randn(B, S_LOCAL, n_global, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)

        _, st_small = group._timed(small, mode=0)  # 拆开形态 d=128 的一次调用

    if rank == 0:
        print(f"ws={ws}  max |packed - three| = {err:.6f}")
        print(f"packed : {t_packed:.3f} ms/iter")
        print(f"three  : {t_three:.3f} ms/iter  ({t_three / t_packed:.2f}x)")
        print(f"packed d=384 stages (ms): { {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in st_big.items()} }")
        print(f"single d=128 stages (ms): { {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in st_small.items()} }")

    # 为什么字节相同、时间不同：
    # 输入侧要搬运的总字节都是 b*s_local*n_global*3*head_dim*elem_size，但每次
    # all_to_all_4d 都要付两道与消息大小基本无关的标志位屏障（barrier_in/barrier_out）

    # copy_out），省下的是 4 道屏障加 2 次 copy_out 的固定延迟，带宽项一分未变。
```

- 等价性一行：`max |packed - three|` 应为 0 或极小（两条路径喂给 SDPA 的 q/k/v 一个是交换缓冲的跨步视图、一个是密集张量，SDPA 可能选不同内核，故用与示例一致的宽容差判断；建议同时打印 `torch.equal(...)` 看是否碰巧逐位相等）。

- 输出等价成立（4.2.4 已从「交换不碰最后一维」给出结构性论证）。

- 若把 `--nproc_per_node=1` 跑一遍：等价性仍成立，但两个版本耗时几乎相同——因为 ws=1 时屏障被整体跳过，延迟项消失。这个「负对照」本身就是对「时间差来自握手」的交叉验证。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `examples/dit_attention.py` 是本库推荐形态的完整样例：fast-ulysses 只交付集合通信，注意力内核与两次调用的编排归调用方；模块因此是普通 `nn.Module`，没有 `autograd.Function` 包装。
- qkv 沿最后一维打包成 \(3 \cdot \text{head\_dim}\)：字节不变、输入侧握手由 3 次并为 1 次；正确性依赖「交换只重排 s/n 轴、从不混合最后一维」，故与最后一维的任何切分可交换；折叠进 n 轴的 5D 变体则是混头的陷阱。
- 校验方法学：与同权重、同数据的单卡参照比较输出**和**输入梯度；`allclose` 而非 `equal`（差异来自 SDPA 的归约顺序，不是交换本身）；先 `.float()` 再求差，容差 `5e-2` 对应 bf16 穿过注意力加两次投影的量纲。
- 五个优化器步证明的是「能训练」而非「一次正确」；梯度自动穿过两次交换（backward = 另一个 mode），loss 是 rank 本地量。
- 成本模型：\(T_{\text{调用}} \approx 2T_{\text{屏障}} + T_{\text{传输}}(\text{字节}) + T_{\text{copy\_out}}\)——打包优化的是按次数计费的延迟项，不是带宽项。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
